answer: An attacker running 74 aliases thus needs 175 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in timber, expire in jetty, and harbor lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4437 identities would post 4573 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
